sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Vimal Kishor Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vimal Kishor Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Triveni Prasad,
the learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
442 of 2022, under Section 406, 419, 420, 120-B, 34 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Tikaitnagar,
District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 24.11.2022 against six persons, including the applicant, alleging that the co-accused Vinod Kumar had executed a sale deed in respect of a piece of land in favour of the informant on 21.09.2021, without disclosing that prior to it, he had already executed an agreement to sell the land on 11.11.2020 in favour of another person.
The F.I.R itself states that the agreement dated 11.11.2020 was duly registered in the office of the Sub Registrar.

Regarding the applicant only this much is alleged that he had cooperated with Deshraj vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. (Home), ... on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10332853/

sentences.text: 4. It is also mentioned in the F.I.R itself that a suit for cancellation of the sale deed is pending in the court of Civil Judge at Barabanki.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant's involvement in four cases has been disclosed in paras 17 and 18 of the affidavit.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the co-accused Vinod Kumar has been granted bail by means of an order dated 25.08.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 10661 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 10661 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the agreement to sell the land executed prior to execution of the sale deed in favour of the informant was duly registered and, therefore, the informant could have easily come to know about the existence of prior agreement by exercise of due diligence; that a suit for cancellation of sale deed is already pending and that the applicant is languishing in jail since 02.01.2023 and that the co-accused Vinod Kumar has already been granted bail, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant-Deshraj be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Pradeep/-
